issues.reason: k1 safety-wiring practice requires live changing serial readings and LED brightness before k2 ADC, k5 PWM, k6 Serial.begin/print. k2 also requires printing but dedicated serial setup is k6, after k3/k4. For the explicit beginner this is an actionable learning-order problem, not merely an optional extra dependency.
repair_options: Use an unpowered wiring/polarity/ground/board-reference checklist for k1; do not require ADC/PWM integration there.

issues.avoid: Do not add k6 as k1 prerequisite: k6 already depends on k3/k4 which depend on k2/k1; that would create a cycle.

changed_fields.after: 保持断电，按官方 Uno 引脚说明逐项核对电位器两端与抽头、共地、LED 极性及串联限流电阻；确认模拟输入电压范围和所选 PWM 引脚，接线检查通过后再进入读数练习。
